scope: Atomic Datly 1.0 report-run adoption and conversation-context CAS
composition: The private custom component starts one managed Datly transaction before reading both current revisions.
It invokes the canonical report_run writer in narrow adoption mode, then the canonical conversation_report_context CAS writer.
A failure in either writer rolls back both table changes; a supplied caller transaction remains caller-owned. No authored component code opens a database or issues SQL.
cases: new pointer adopts completed run atomically
stale run revision fails before writes
stale context revision fails before writes
late pointer failure rolls back run adoption
legacy_comparison: Seven managed cases execute the original SDK0 AdoptReportRunAndContextCAS against independent SQLite fixtures and compare success/failure plus persisted run revision, conversation and pointer revision. The late pointer trigger proves legacy and SDK1 both roll back the run update.
contention: Two independent SQLite connections racing to adopt the same expected revisions yield exactly one success and a consistent run/context pair in ten repeated test runs.
host_linkage: The linked host now registers all named factory functions as well as types. The real in-process standalone host invokes the private ReportAdoption route and commits the run/context pair; earlier E2E custom-runtime tests did not exercise this host registry path.
